messages.subject: [Riskassessment-news] mc2d Version 1.0-14 is available
messages.body_plain:
Dear mc2d users,

A new version of the R package mc2d is available on the CRAN 
 No real new
features but some bugs fix and an improved documentation thanks to JBD.


R. Pouillot.

Version 0.1-14
=============

BUG FIX

- one bug for multivariates nodes with truncation was corrected
- addition of tests for truncations (function rtrunc and mcstoc (option
trunc=TRUE)). Some unexpected results linked to rounding errors could be
obtained for some extreme truncations (see examples). Note that it is not
possible to catch all errors and a warning is now provided in the
documentation.

IMPROVEMENTS

- pert is definitively better and quicker.
- the vignettes were revised
